test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having numbers 1 to 6. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '1'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71b882f65416d316a101dcf74a928e6de3012adc9b9925b4c412e0588b76a07c.png]
solution: As 3 and 5 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 1 and 6 are opposite to each other.
